description: Choose one or more modes: subreddit posts, comment trees, keyword search, user profiles, or subreddit metadata. All modes work without an account, API key, or login.

authorAllowlist.description: Keep only records by these exact usernames (case-insensitive).
authorAllowlist.title: Only these authors

authorBlocklist.description: Drop records by these exact usernames (case-insensitive).
authorBlocklist.title: Exclude these authors

authorFilter.description: Keep only records whose author name contains this text (case-insensitive).
authorFilter.title: Author contains

commentSort.description: How to order comments inside a thread.
commentSort.title: Comment sort order

domainFilter.description: Keep only posts whose link domain contains this text (case-insensitive).
domainFilter.title: Link domain contains

enrichSearchResults.description: Open the first few search-result posts to fill score, comment count, body and media. Disable for the fastest search runs.
enrichSearchResults.title: Load full post details for search results

excludeNsfw.description: Drop posts Reddit flags as NSFW (18+).
excludeNsfw.title: Exclude NSFW posts

excludeStickied.description: Drop pinned/stickied posts from listings and search results.
excludeStickied.title: Exclude stickied posts

expandThreads.description: Load collapsed 'more comments' branches and additional profile pages when available.
expandThreads.title: Expand comment trees

flairFilter.description: Keep only posts whose link flair contains this text (case-insensitive).
flairFilter.title: Flair contains

includePost.description: Emit the parent post record in comments mode in addition to its comments.
includePost.title: Include the post alongside its comments

includeRules.description: Add the public rules list to subreddit metadata records.
includeRules.title: Include community rules

includeSubredditInfo.description: Emit one subreddit metadata record per community in posts mode.
includeSubredditInfo.title: Include community details with posts

keywordFilter.description: Keep only posts or comments whose title, body or text contains this text (case-insensitive).
keywordFilter.title: Keyword filter

maxAgeDays.description: Drop posts and comments older than this many days.
maxAgeDays.title: Maximum age in days

maxComments.description: Stop after this many comments for each post URL.
maxComments.title: Maximum comments per post

maxDepth.description: In comments mode, drop comments nested deeper than this level.
maxDepth.title: Maximum comment depth

maxItems.description: Global safety cap for the whole run, across all modes.
maxItems.title: Maximum total records

maxPostComments.description: Keep only posts that have at most this many comments.
maxPostComments.title: Maximum post comment count

maxPosts.description: Stop after this many posts for each subreddit or profile.
maxPosts.title: Maximum posts per community or user

maxScore.description: Drop posts and comments with a higher score. Leave empty for no maximum.
maxScore.title: Maximum score

maxSearchResults.description: Cap search results (posts or comments) for each query.
maxSearchResults.title: Maximum search results per query

minComments.description: Keep only posts that have at least this many comments.
minComments.title: Minimum post comment count

minScore.description: Drop posts and comments with a lower score. Leave empty for no minimum.
minScore.title: Minimum score

minUpvoteRatio.description: Keep only posts at or above this upvote ratio (0 to 1).
minUpvoteRatio.title: Minimum upvote ratio

mode.description: Run one mode. Prefer `modes` to combine modes in a single run.
mode.title: Mode (single)

modes.description: Run multiple modes in one execution, for example ["posts", "search"]. When set, this overrides the single `mode` field.
modes.title: Modes (run several at once)

postType.description: Keep only posts of this type. Choose 'all' to keep every type.
postType.title: Post type

postUrls.description: Reddit post URLs or bare post IDs to read comment trees from.
postUrls.title: Post URLs or IDs (comments mode)

postedAfter.description: Keep only posts created on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC).
postedAfter.title: Posted on or after

postedBefore.description: Keep only posts created on or before this date (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC).
postedBefore.title: Posted on or before

searchQueries.description: Keywords for search mode. Supports Reddit search syntax such as author:, flair:, site:, quotes, AND/OR/NOT and -exclusions.
searchQueries.title: Search keywords or phrases

searchType.description: Search for posts, comments, or both.
searchType.title: Search result type

section.description: Which part of a user's profile to read.
section.title: Profile section

sort.description: How to sort subreddit listings and profile posts.
sort.title: Post sort order

subreddits.description: Communities to read for posts, comments or subreddit details. Accepts bare names, r/ prefixes, or full Reddit URLs.
subreddits.title: Subreddits

timeFilter.description: Time range for top/controversial sorts and search.
timeFilter.title: Time window

usernames.description: Reddit users to read. Accepts plain names, u/ prefixes, or full profile URLs.
usernames.title: Usernames (users mode)

withinCommunity.description: Restrict search results to a single subreddit. Leave empty to search all of Reddit.
withinCommunity.title: Search inside one community (optional)

title: Reddit Research Scraper Input
